book: Amazons vs Valkyries: Cult of Ares

body:
Machaidaemon
CR 10

This hulking, nightmarish daemon is made of blades, spikes, and fire.

XP 9,600
NE Medium outsider (daemon, evil, extraplanar)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +23

Aura frightful presence (10 ft., DC 18)

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 14, flat-footed 20 (+4 Dex, +10 natural)
hp +138 (13d10+54)
Fort +13, Ref +11, Will +5; +2 racial bonus vs. spells and spell-like abilities
DR 10/law; Immune acid, death effects, disease and poison; Resist cold 10, electricity 10, fire 10; SR 22

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 slams +16 (1d8+6) or longsword +16/+11 (1d8+6)
Ranged javelin +14/+9 (1d6+6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 13; Charisma-based)

At will—divine favor
3/day—agonizing rebuke (DC 16), barbed chains (DC 14)
1/day—heroism, summon (level 4; 1 ceustodaemon 50%)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 18, Con 23, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 16
Base Atk +10; CMB +16; CMD 30
Feats Cleave, Improved Natural Attack, Power Attack, Toughness, Vital Strike
Skills Bluff +13, Intimidate +19, Knowledge (planes) +10, Perception +23, Sense Motive +18, Spellcraft +11, Stealth +20, Survival +12; Racial Modifiers +8 Perception
Languages Abyssal, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 100 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Arcane Touch (Su)

All weapon attacks made by a Machaidaemon are considered to be magic for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Blaze (Su)

Once per day, as a free action, a Machaidaemon can immolate itself in flames. All adjacent creatures must make a Reflex saving throw. A creature takes 10d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

Flurry of Fists (Ex)

Whenever a Machaidaemon uses the full-attack action when attacking with its slams, it can make one additional slam against the same target.

Malicious Assault (Ex)

Whenever a Machaidaemon makes a successful slam attack against a creature suffering from a fear effect, the Machaidaemon deals an additional amount of fire damage equal to twice its Charisma modifier.

Unshakable (Su)

A Machaidaemon is immune to magical and non-magical fear effects.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Hades or the Void)
Organization solitary, pair, or gang (3-10)
Treasure standard

The Machaidaemon, embodiments of primordial chaos and unrelenting strife, descend upon the mortal realm as agents of discord and destruction.

Cloaked in darkness with hide like steel plates that oozes the very essence of chaos, a Machaidaemon’s presence alone instills fear and despair. With eyes that burn like smoldering embers, they witness the chaos they sow with a sadistic delight.

In the heat of battle, the Machaidaemon become an embodiment of merciless brutality. Their strikes are swift and precise, leaving trails of carnage in their wake. Each swing of their mighty swords carries the weight of shattered realms and broken spirits. They thrive on the fear and anguish of their adversaries, relishing the symphony that rings through the battlefield.
